Intermediate.learningGoal: Own and release resources correctly with using and IDisposable.
gotchas: Using an object after it's disposed should throw ObjectDisposedException
Dispose must be safe to call twice
goodSolutionShows: using declarations at the right scope
shapeHints: a scoped timer that logs elapsed time on dispose

gotchas: await using vs using on IAsyncDisposable
A class owning several disposables must dispose all even if one throws
Finalizers are almost never needed for managed resources
goodSolutionShows: All owned resources released when one Dispose throws
shapeHints: a buffered writer that flushes on dispose
a connection wrapper owning a stream and a timer

Expert.learningGoal: Get the full dispose pattern right for subclassing and unmanaged handles.
gotchas: SafeHandle instead of IntPtr plus finalizer
Dispose(bool disposing) must not touch managed objects from the finalizer
goodSolutionShows: SafeHandle or a clear reason not to need it
shapeHints: a base class for resource-owning services
a pooled object that returns itself on dispose
